name: Telf Joolam
summary: At the Shrine of the Dormant Flame, Telf Joolam guides Horde initiates through the trials of fire. The Darkspear shaman teaches them to commune with and command the volatile element.

sections.title: Keeper of the Flame
sections.body: Telf Joolam tends the Shrine of the Dormant Flame among the crags overlooking the borderlands. Fire spirits demand sharp discipline and unwavering focus, unlike the calm certainty of earth or the patient depth of water. Telf prepares young shamans for trials that test their worth before the wild embers consume them.

sections.title: The Path of Fire
sections.body: Under Telf's direction, initiates brew and drink a ritual Fire Sapta, opening their mortal eyes to the unseen elemental planes. He sends them up the rocky summits to face burning spirits. Those who earn the flame must respect its ravenous hunger and resist reckless pride.

faq.answer: Telf Joolam is a Darkspear troll shaman who tends the Shrine of the Dormant Flame. He mentors young shamans seeking to commune with fire.

faq.q: Where can Telf Joolam be found?
faq.answer: Telf Joolam can be found at the Shrine of the Dormant Flame, high along the rocky ridge between Durotar and the Barrens.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Fire Sapta he asks for?
faq.answer: The Fire Sapta opens an initiate's spiritual vision, letting them perceive and speak with elemental fire spirits invisible to mortal senses.

faq.q: What element does Telf Joolam teach?
faq.answer: Telf Joolam teaches the element of fire, testing shamans' strength and will to control flame without falling to its destructive nature.

faq.q: Why is a troll overseeing shamanic rites here?
faq.answer: Since joining Thrall's Horde, many Darkspear trolls have taken up shamanism alongside orcs and tauren. Experienced shamans like Telf guide the next generation.

faq.q: What happens after completing Telf Joolam's tasks?
faq.answer: After proving mastery over the flame spirits on the nearby peak, initiates gain the knowledge and blessing needed to forge their permanent Fire Totem.

angles.text: As a shaman, you follow Telf Joolam's guidance through the Fire Sapta trials and learn to master your Fire Totem.
As a troll, you see a Darkspear elder guiding initiates in the shamanic ways shared across the Horde.
As a member of the Horde, you see elders like Telf safeguard sacred elemental shrines throughout the borderlands, strengthening the Horde's spiritual roots.
